newsitem.title: CANADA: DOMINION RATES LOEWEN SENIOR DEBT AT BBB.
newsitem.headline: DOMINION RATES LOEWEN SENIOR DEBT AT BBB.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd said Thursday it rated the Loewen Group Inc's senior debt securities at BBB (low) with a stable trend.

Loewen, North America's second biggest funeral home operator, has several strengths including favorable demographics, expected growth in its cemetery and insurance businesses and good returns in aspects of its funeral business, Dominion said.
Loewen's capital demands are "enormous" because of an aggressive acquisition program and debt coverage ratios are relatively low, it said.

But capital expenditure can usually be financed by cash flow and protective debt covenants are in place. "Thus there is sufficient justification for the company's level of leverage," the agency said. ((Reuters Vancouver Bureau (604) 664-7314))
